description: Read-only pricing preview: same validation and credit math as a real generation, without spending credits. When to use: always immediately before any generate_* call; tell the user the number of credits and pass max_credits accordingly. Returns: estimated credit cost and breakdown fields. motion_control uses the motion clip length; video_edit uses source length; video_extend uses source plus extension. Genjutsu Explore: pass template_slug. Does not enqueue jobs.
